name: SFA: Sales Force Automation
desc: A field sales app for reps on the move: attendance with location, targets vs. achievement for calls, visits, sales and collections, beat plans and pending sales orders.
impact: I built live location monitoring, the beat-plan, price and "more info" tabs, sales-vs-collection charts, the product comparison table and the incentive screens.
solved: Being on Wi-Fi didn't mean the internet worked, so I built a network checker that probes Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) and Google (8.8.8.8) every 5 seconds and alerts the user when the connection drops. It now runs in both the CRM/SFA and ERP apps.
Reps and managers work in the Nepali calendar, so I moved collection dates, months and sales reports to Bikram Sambat dates.

name: CRM: Lead & Customer Management
desc: Manages the sales pipeline from lead capture to close: lead KPIs, timelines, quotations and win/loss dashboards.
impact: I built lead creation with an approval flow, product tagging with notifications, quotation PDFs (payment details, VAT, alternate units), terms & conditions, lead reassignment, and the to-do calendar with comments and attachments.
solved: Leads could be quoted below allowed prices, so I enforced discount limits on submit and re-checked the whole lead's product total during approval.

name: ESS: Employee Self-Service
desc: A dedicated employee app split out of the ERP: check in/out with live location, attendance summary, leave and loan requests, and the holiday calendar.
impact: I built check-in/out with distance tracking in meters, meal (tiffin) and overtime entries, and the holiday calendar.

name: PB Smart: ERP Management App
desc: The management app of the core ERP that SFA, CRM and ESS plug into: quick info across sales, collection, payment, purchase and production, with drill-down reports.
impact: I built the net sales, net purchase, cost contribution and customer-group reports (with 2-D scrolling tables), the vehicle information section, and login by username or phone number.
solved: PDF and Excel downloads failed on the web build, so I added platform checks so exports work on Android, iOS and web.

name: SVM: Service Management
desc: A client app for running rented land and shops: staff collect daily rent by scanning a customer's QR code or searching by ID, name or phone, and validate entry tickets at the gate with a QR scan.
impact: I built the whole app myself from the client's requirements: QR and manual rent collection, today's paid and pending customers, a dashboard with date-range totals, monthly collection reports per customer, ticket validation with a scan history, and module-wise rights so each user only sees the sections they're allowed.
solved: Rent is agreed monthly but collected every day, and Nepali months run 29 to 32 days, so the app works out the per-day amount from the days in the current Bikram Sambat month.

A ticket could be shown twice at the gate, so every scan is checked with the server. A reused ticket shows "Already Used" with the time it was first scanned, and a failed request can be scanned again.

name: Digital Khata: Expense Tracker
desc: An offline-first personal and shop expense tracker. Data lives on the device in Hive and syncs to a Flask + MySQL backend with JWT auth.
points: CSV (Excel) and PDF export, backup & restore
Biometric app lock and secure storage

name: eCommerce App
desc: An offline-first eCommerce app with authentication, product listing and cart, built with MVC architecture and REST API integration.

name: HouseHunt: Property Search
desc: A property listing and search app with location and criteria-based filtering, backed by a Django REST API.
